edition.commentator: 朱熹; the heading in book 1 PDF page 22 says 朱熹本義
edition.commonsEditionMetadata: 清同治十三年（1874）江南書局刻本
edition.publisherConflict: The image reads 江西, while Commons description metadata says 江南. Keep both assertions; not resolved by silently changing either.
edition.sourceInstitutionAsCreditedByCommons: National Center for Philosophy and Social Sciences Documentation
edition.institutionDirectCatalogAccess: The Commons template identifies the ncpssd.org barcode URLs; direct catalog was inaccessible to the web reader. No claim of independently downloading the PDF from the institution.

method: manual-visual-transcription; large-type original statement only; no OCR
comparisonPolicy: NFC, punctuation/spacing removed, no allograph folding. A mismatch is not automatically a source error.
scope: Six ordinary yao for each of 64 hexagrams; supplementary 用九/用六 separate. One visually inspected edition only; no full commentary transcription.
limitations: All 384 statements have been visually read and transcribed once, with targeted second looks. This is not two-reader adjudication.
Original printed allographs are represented by available Unicode characters; typography and punctuation are not facsimile-encoded.
The two PDFs are two volumes of one edition, not two independent historical witnesses.
Public corpus and interpretations were not changed by this research.
Reading all yao statements does not equal extracting all commentary, all 十翼, or all knowledge in the work.
